steps.datamodel:
datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model AboutSection {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  quote     String
  ctaText   String   @default("More About Us")
  ctaUrl    String   @default("/about")
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  order     Int      @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([isActive, order])
  @@map("about_sections")
}
